why: Found on the demo inbox (without the model): "please send the $4,800 payment" wasn't caught because of the amount in the middle, and a payment to new bank details was labelled as a receipt. Asking you to send an amount is asking for money.

email.subject: Booking your roof repair
email.body: Hi Sam, we can fit your roof repair in on the 14th. Please send the $1,250 deposit by Friday so we can hold the date. Thanks, Mike
